 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The Golden State Warriors try to get back on the winning track when they take on the New Orleans Pelicans on Monday. The game begins at 8 PM ET and will air on Gulf Coast Sports, Pelicans+, NBCS-BA, and PCK-GS.
 After winning eight straight, the Warriors have lost two straight. They were blown out by the San Antonio Spurs in their last game, 123-85. They are 8-5 on the season, 9th in the West. This is the third game on a five-game road trip. The Warriors are 8th in offense and 12th in defense.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The Pelicans come into this game as losers of six straight, falling to the Denver Nuggets, 116-108, in their last game. They are 4-10 on the year, 13th in the West. This is their third game on a five-game homestand. They have the 20th ranked offense and the 30th ranked defense.
 These two teams met on November 9, with the Warriors picking up a 138-87 victory. Steph Cury and Brandin Podziemski each had 25 points while Yaxel Lendeborg had 23 points. De'Anthony Melton, LJ Cryer, and Charles Bassey were all in double figures off the bench. Derik Queen had 16 points to lead the Pelicans.
 Golden State Warriors Injury Report
 Stephen Curry is OUT with a right oblique tear. On November 12, it was reported that Curry would miss close to one month with the injury.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Gui Santos is QUESTIONABLE with right ankle inflammation. Santos played 21 minutes against the Spurs, finishing with seven points and four rebounds. In ten games this season, he averaging 5.6 points, 3.9 rebounds, and 1.4 assists.
 Brandon Williams is OUT with a left hamstring strain. On November 10, it was reported that he would miss at least one week.
 Kelley L Cox-Imagn Images
 Jimmy Butler III is OUT after undergoing ACL surgery in January. He is hopeful to return in early 2027.
 Moses Moody is OUT after undergoing patellar tendon surgery in March. He is hopeful to return in late 2026 or early 2027.
 Kristaps Porzingis is OUT as he is not with the team and has stepped away from basketball for the foreseeable future.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The Warriors started Will Richard, Yaxel Lendeborg , Brandin Podziemski, De'Anthony Melton, and Draymond Green against the Spurs.
 LJ Cryer, Santos, and Charles Bassey all played more than 20 minutes off the bench, though everyone got playing time in the blowout loss.
 New Orleans Pelicans Injury Report
 Trey Murphy III is OUT with bilateral patellar tendinopathy. He last played on November 8, missing the last four games.
 Dejounte Murray is OUT with a left ankle sprain. He last played on November 11, missing the last two games.
 Bennedict Mathurin is OUT with left plantar fasciitis. Played ten minutes against the Grizzlies and did not play against the Nuggets.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Trendon Watford is OUT with a right ankle sprain. He last played on November 8.
 Bryce McGowens is OUT with a left elbow infection. He last played on November 11.
 Malik Dia, Jaron Pierre Jr., and Julian Reese are all QUESTIONABLE on G League two-way deals.
 Saddiq Bey, Jeremiah Fears, Zion Williamson, Herbert Jones, and Yves Missi started against the Nuggets.
 Derik Queen, Jordan Poole, and Jaron Pierre Jr. all played more than 23 minutes off the bench. Karlo Matkovic also got minutes off the bench.
